gloss: diagonal cut; cutting on a bias

definitions.gloss: diagonal cut; cutting on a bias
definitions.explanation: a cutting technique where vegetables or other ingredients are sliced at an angle rather than straight across, increasing surface area and improving appearance

examples.japanese: ねぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{斜|なな}め{切|ぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Cutting diagonally makes the heat penetrate faster.

examples.japanese: きゅうり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{斜|なな}め{切|ぎ}りにして⟦{酢|す}の{物|もの}→酢の物：04982_sunomono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}えた→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: I sliced the cucumber diagonally and added it to the vinegared dish.

notes:
{斜|なな}め{切|ぎ}り is a cutting technique where ingredients are sliced at an angle rather than straight across.

USAGE:
Commonly used for long, cylindrical vegetables like ⟦{長|なが}ねぎ→長ねぎ：14827_naganegi⟧ (green onion), きゅうり (cucumber), ごぼう (burdock root), and ⟦セロリ→セロリ：25680_serori⟧ (celery). The diagonal cut creates larger surface area, which helps seasonings absorb better and reduces cooking time.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {斜|なな}め{切|ぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cut diagonally
- ⟦{斜|なな}め→斜め：00303_naname⟧⟦{薄切|うすぎ}り→薄切り：07475_usugiri⟧: thin diagonal slices

RELATED CUTTING TECHNIQUES:
- ⟦{輪切|わぎ}り→輪切り：07474_wagiri⟧: round slices (straight across)
- ⟦{半月切|はんげつぎ}り→半月切り：08091_hangetsugiri⟧: half-moon slices
- ⟦{乱切|らんぎ}り→乱切り：08067_rangiri⟧: rough/random cut
- ⟦{千切|せんぎ}り→千切り：07473_sengiri⟧: julienne (thin strips)
- {微塵切|みじんぎ}り: mincing
